"''Seeing that the key part of secret base is the secret location, no, it will not work out!|Ezra Bridger and Kanan Jarrus, as they dueled a pair of Inquisitors on Oosalon|}} '''Oosalon''' was a barren, [[mountain]]ous [[planet]] located in [[the galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories]]. ==Description== Oosalon{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/shroud-of-darkness-trivia-gallery|text="Shroud of Darkness" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 1}} was a barren, rocky [[mountain]]ous [[planet]] located in [[the galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories]]. The planet had an [[atmosphere]] breathable to [[oxygen]]-breathers, such as [[human]]s. The planet was inhabited by a [[Sentience|non-sentient]] creature named the [[tibidee]]. ==History== {{Quote|Ahhh, so that is why the great master Mace Windu has deigned to visit this backwater of a planet—to pass his sanctimonious judgment.|Guattako, to Mace Windu|}} [[File:MaceWinduGetsKnockedOut-TheWeapon.jpg|thumb|left|192x192px|Mace Windu gets knocked out by Guattako's staff.]] In [[34 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' [[Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu]] was captured by the [[warlord]] [[Guattako]]'s [[Guattako's army|army]] while searching for missing children that Guattako had kidnapped. After capturing Windu, they broke [[Mace Windu's lightsaber|his]] [[lightsaber]] and were planning to broadcast Windu's [[Death|execution]] across the [[galaxy]] so the [[Jedi]]'s death could inspire many new converts into his cause. However, Windu was able to use the Force to reconstruct his lightsaber. When he met with Guattako, he fought with him until he was knocked out by his staff. When Guattako was going to kill Windu, a young child shot and killed Guattako. Windu and the missing children were then rescued. Around [[33 BBY]],{{JangoFettSeriesDate}} [[Jango Fett]] captured the gambler [[Fissark Tozan]] in a [[secret gambling den]] on Oosalon in order to collect on the bounty on his head for owing the [[Crymorah Syndicate]] a [[sabacc]] debt. After capturing his target, Jango dropped a [[thermal detonator]] on the gambling den’s remaining patrons. [[File:Kanan_and_Ezra_fight_the_Inquisitors.png|thumb|right|224x224px|Kanan and Ezra fight the Inquisitorius on Oosalon.]] In [[3 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of the episode "[[Shroud of Darkness]]," which includes the [[Duel on Oosalon]], to [[3 BBY]]. two [[Spectres|rebels]]—the Jedi [[Kanan Jarrus]] and his Padawan, [[Ezra Bridger]]—scouted Oosalon as a potential location for a rebel base. Instead, they were confronted by two [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Inquisitorius|Inquisitors]], the [[Seventh Sister]] and the [[Fifth Brother]], and engaged them in a [[Duel on Oosalon|lightsaber duel]] on [[Oosalon Mesa]] before escaping on the back of a tibidee. {{Planet-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== Oosalon first appeared unnamed in "[[Shroud of Darkness]]," the sixteenth episode of the [[canon]] animated series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|second season]], which first aired on [[March 2]], [[2016]].{{WebCite|url=http://affiliate.zap2it.com/tv/star-wars-rebels/EP018796240049?aid=dxd|text=Star Wars Rebels: Shroud of Darkness|work=Disney XD Official Schedule|archivedate=20160407082132}} It was later identified in the "Shroud of Darkness" episode guide trivia gallery, which confirmed that it was identified as Oosalon in the episodes script. ==Appearances== *{{StoryCite|story=The
